This is a Kotlin Multiplatform repo for native D-Bus support.

Layout: `src/commonMain/kotlin` (shared API/serialization); `src/nativeMain/kotlin` + `src/nativeInterop/cinterop` (Linux native impl + C interop); `src/nativeTest/kotlin/{unit,integration,mocks}` (native tests/fixtures); `codegen/` (JVM XML→Kotlin code generation); `plugin/` (`com.monkopedia.sdbus.plugin` built on `:codegen`); `compile_test/` (compile-time wiring); `samples/bluez-scan/` (example consumer).

Gradle wrapper from repo root: `./gradlew build` full build; `./gradlew test` run JVM/native tests; `./gradlew ktlintCheck` style; `./gradlew licenseCheck` headers/required checks; `./gradlew dokkaHtml` docs to `build/dokka`; release/docs workflows run `gradle publish codegen:fatJar` and `gradle dokkaHtml` on Ubuntu. Follow `.editorconfig` (4-space indent, LF, max line length 100). Kotlin style via `ktlint` (`android_studio` profile). Naming: `UpperCamelCase` classes, `lowerCamelCase` functions/properties, clear `com.monkopedia.sdbus` packages.
